We welcome contact from external researchers and organisations, in particular in the **transfer areas** of the project:

::: {.transfer-grid}
<div class="transfer-item"><b>Water</b><br>Inequality in household water consumption and expenditure</div>
<div class="transfer-item"><b>Tourism</b><br>Effect of tourism on income inequality</div>
<div class="transfer-item"><b>Firms</b><br>Servitization, digital transformation and AI adoption</div>
<div class="transfer-item"><b>Regional inequality and global convergence</b><br>Bias-corrected inequality across regions and countries</div>
<div class="transfer-item"><b>Methods and software</b><br>Bias correction, jackknife inference and the R package <i>theil</i></div>
:::

## Send us a message

The form opens your email application with the message ready to send. No data are stored on this website.

```{=html}
<!-- To change the contact address, edit CONTACT_EMAIL below (one line). -->
<form id="contact-form" class="contact-form" onsubmit="return theiluminaContact(event)">
  <div class="row g-3">
    <div class="col-md-6"><label class="form-label" for="cf-name">Name</label>
      <input class="form-control" id="cf-name" required></div>
    <div class="col-md-6"><label class="form-label" for="cf-inst">Institution</label>
      <input class="form-control" id="cf-inst"></div>
    <div class="col-md-6"><label class="form-label" for="cf-area">Area of interest</label>
      <select class="form-select" id="cf-area">
        <option>Methods (bias, inference, computational efficiency)</option>
        <option>R package theil</option>
        <option>Water</option>
        <option>Tourism</option>
        <option>Firms: servitization, digital transformation and AI</option>
        <option>Regional inequality and global convergence</option>
        <option>Data sharing</option>
        <option>Seminars, visits and research stays</option>
        <option>Other</option>
      </select></div>
    <div class="col-md-6"><label class="form-label" for="cf-type">Type of collaboration</label>
      <select class="form-select" id="cf-type">
        <option>Joint research or co-authorship</option>
        <option>Applying the methods to my data</option>
        <option>Seminar or conference invitation</option>
        <option>Research stay</option>
        <option>Information about the project</option>
      </select></div>
    <div class="col-12"><label class="form-label" for="cf-msg">Message</label>
      <textarea class="form-control" id="cf-msg" rows="5" required></textarea></div>
    <div class="col-12"><button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit">Prepare email</button></div>
  </div>
</form>
<script>
const CONTACT_EMAIL = "jfmunoz@ugr.es";
function theiluminaContact(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  const v = id => document.getElementById(id).value.trim();
  const subject = `[THEILUMINA] Collaboration: ${v("cf-area")}`;
  const body = `Name: ${v("cf-name")}\nInstitution: ${v("cf-inst")}\nArea of interest: ${v("cf-area")}\nType of collaboration: ${v("cf-type")}\n\n${v("cf-msg")}`;
  window.location.href = `mailto:${CONTACT_EMAIL}?subject=${encodeURIComponent(subject)}&body=${encodeURIComponent(body)}`;
  return false;
}
</script>
```

## Other ways to get in touch

- **Email:** [jfmunoz@ugr.es](mailto:jfmunoz@ugr.es)
- **Principal investigators:** [Juan Francisco Muñoz Rosas](https://scholar.google.es/citations?user=gedX7Z8AAAAJ&hl=es&oi=ao) and [Encarnación Álvarez Verdejo](https://scholar.google.es/citations?user=dBLU8iAAAAAJ&hl=es&oi=ao), Department of Quantitative Methods for Economics and Business, Faculty of Economics and Business, University of Granada (Spain).
- **Code and data:** suggestions and issues can be posted in the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/jfmunozrosas/theilumina/issues).
- **Project identity:** logos for your presentations and publications are available on the [identity page](identity.qmd).
